raboot-stacking.cards:
Raboot [C1 023, C1 137] Jumping Coach: As long as this Pokémon is in play, flip 3 more coins for the Rabbit Jumping attack used by your Pokémon.
Scorbunny [C1 022] Rabbit Jumping [C] 20x: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
raboot-stacking.engine: DeckGym: each Raboot in play adds 3 coins, so two Raboot flip 8.
raboot-stacking.look: How many coins Rabbit Jumping flips: 8 (2 + 3 + 3, they stack) or 5 (only one counts).
raboot-stacking.other: Only one Jumping Coach counts: 5 coins.
raboot-stacking.setup: Solo battle. Scorbunny Active with 1 Energy, and two Raboot on your Bench. Use Rabbit Jumping.
raboot-stacking.sofar: Captured Oct 28 (ScreenRecording_10-28-2026 23-45-00_1.mp4): two Raboot stack, 8 coins. Matches DeckGym.
raboot-stacking.title: Raboot's Jumping Coach: do two Raboot add 6 coins?
